messages:
megan: Mid-morning handoff — I'm out at 12:30pm PT. Quick notes:
- Deploy rolled to prod (runtimes) around 10:50 — no errors in rollout.
- Watch: us-west2 token latency up ~15-20% last 30m, likely KV cache cold starts.
- Action: increase cache warmup batch for the small-model pool to 64 for the next hour.

ali: noted. I'll take first 30m of coverage after you.

jamie: Any PRs blocking the config change? Which file to edit?

megan: config: `infra/serving/cache_policies.yaml` change `warmup_batch: 32 -> 64` and bump `grace_period` to `600s` for small-model-pool. No new PR needed if you patch via hotfix CI job.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #5267 completed — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

sourabh: saw a small uptick in 5xx from reroute service when us-west2 spiked. Might be cascading timeouts. Lowering retry backoff helps. Suggest transient route to eu-west1 for non-low-latency customers.

ali: taking that. I'll flip policy to prefer eu-west1 for tier=standard for next 45m. Ping me if that breaks anything.

jamie: I'll open PR for the cache change and link the hotfix run: PR #4789 — testing on staging now.

megan: Thanks. Also FYI: scheduled maintenance database vacuum at 02:00 UTC tonight — may affect embeddings ingestion latency. No action unless we see errors.

ali: noted. My post-handoff checklist:
- watch us-west2 1min p50/p95
- keep an eye on reroute errors
- follow up on PR #4789

jamie: If anyone sees tail latency > 500ms in small-model-pool, please @ali and I'll rollback warmup if needed. :eyes:

megan: All set. Leave any follow-ups here and I'll check notifications before leaving. No incident yet, just FYI and coordination.
